images.title: The augmented LLM
images.credit: Source: Anthropic, Building effective agents (2024), The augmented LLM. Original published figure, reproduced unmodified.
images.caption: Anthropic's augmented-LLM building block connects a model with retrieval, tools and memory. It describes available capabilities, rather than proving a particular deployment is autonomous.
images.educational_use: A source-grounded reference for the distinction between a model and the supporting components of an application. Prefer one large reference figure in the reading guide or a focused slide.
images.visual_qa: Original inspected. Clear, low-density labels; at 1280px full width the 2.401:1 image occupies about 533px height. Avoid placing it in a narrow multi-figure grid.
images.reuse_license: No explicit image license verified; attribution is supplied, not a claim of an open license.
images.assumptions: Published conceptual pattern, not an implementation diagram of PowerAgent, PowerDAG or a utility deployment.

images.title: Autonomous agent
images.credit: Source: Anthropic, Building effective agents (2024), Autonomous agent. Original published figure, reproduced unmodified.
images.caption: The published loop connects an LLM call, environment actions and feedback, with human interaction and a stopping path. This is a practitioner pattern, not a universal definition of every classical agent.
images.educational_use: The more immediately useful source figure for explaining feedback and stop conditions. Compare with the tutorial's concrete v43 loop without implying a measured utility implementation.
images.visual_qa: Original inspected. Large labels and few elements remain suitable at full 1280px width; expected display height is about 533px. Preserve attribution and do not shrink into a dense slide panel.
images.reuse_license: No explicit image license verified; attribution is supplied, not a claim of an open license.
images.assumptions: Published conceptual pattern, not an implementation diagram of PowerAgent, PowerDAG or a utility deployment.
